nodes.label: Nocturn Tagline
nodes.rationale: Brand tagline: 'Nocturn. La noche es tuya. Descubrelo.'

nodes.label: Prisma Schema Rules
nodes.rationale: UUID string IDs (never autoincrement), createdAt/updatedAt timestamps, UPPERCASE enums, onDelete Cascade for child relations, composite @@unique and @@index for frequent filters, db push without formal migrations.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Premium Design System
nodes.rationale: Curated dark palette #0B0B0E / #1E1E24 with gold accent #D4AF37, glassmorphism, never flat colors.

nodes.label: Reviews Module
nodes.rationale: create/update/delete must recalculate perfume.rating and reviewCount; @@unique([userId, perfumeId]) handled with a descriptive Spanish error.

nodes.label: Aura
nodes.rationale: Premium perfume e-commerce (decants and full bottles) built on Next.js 16 App Router with TypeScript 5 strict, PostgreSQL via Prisma 7.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Premium Design System
nodes.rationale: Premium dark theme: bg #0B0B0E, surfaces #1E1E24, gold accent #D4AF37, text secondary #A0A0A8.

nodes.label: Favorites Module
nodes.rationale: User to Perfume many-to-many via @relation("FavoritePerfumes"); optimistic updates via useMutation; unauthenticated toggles redirect to /login.

nodes.label: Prisma Singleton (db)
nodes.rationale: @/lib/db.ts exports a Prisma singleton via @prisma/adapter-pg; importable only from actions.ts, never from components or hooks.

nodes.label: Reviews Module
nodes.rationale: One review per (userId, perfumeId) enforced by @@unique; creating/editing/deleting recalculates perfume.rating and reviewCount; lazy-validation eligibility checked on click.

nodes.label: Aura Subscription
nodes.rationale: Configurable monthly fee (not hardcoded) for exclusive benefits to drive retention and recurring revenue; auto-renews monthly; lives in src/modules/subscription/ and links to the User model.

nodes.label: Data Model Entities
nodes.rationale: Core entities User, Perfume, Order, OrderItem, Decant, Designer, Category, Note, Tag, Review, Banner, Vibe; community metrics are 1:1 with Perfume.

nodes.label: Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: Next.js 16.2.4 App Router, React 19.2.4, Prisma ^7.8.0 with @prisma/adapter-pg, PostgreSQL, Tailwind v4, Framer Motion, react-query, Zustand, Zod, Lucide, S3.

nodes.label: Product Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Task board tracking frontend, backend and completed work including pending auth flows, full-text search, rate limiting and cart-to-server sync.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md Reference
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md simply imports AGENTS.md (@AGENTS.md) so agents follow the same project rules.

nodes.label: UPPERCASE Enum Convention
nodes.rationale: All enum values UPPERCASE across Prisma, Zod, actions and frontend to keep serialized values consistent (DELIVERY, VES, PENDING).

nodes.label: Documentation System
nodes.rationale: Markdown docs under docs/modules, docs/api, docs/decisions (ADRs), docs/changelog; document the 'why' and business logic, not obvious code.

nodes.label: React Query (Server State)
nodes.rationale: @tanstack/react-query v5 for all server-backed data, one file per query/mutation in module hooks/, optimistic updates via useMutation.

nodes.label: Zustand (Client State)
nodes.rationale: Zustand only for purely local client state such as drawer open, active modal, and auth token; server data stays out of Zustand.

nodes.label: Feature Planning Workflow
nodes.rationale: Implementation order schema to actions to API route to hook to components to page; delegate subtasks to specific agents; 24 modules in src/modules/.

nodes.label: Testing Stack
nodes.rationale: No test framework installed yet; recommends Vitest + @testing-library/react for unit/integration and Playwright for E2E; mock Prisma with vi.mock('@/lib/db').

nodes.label: Server/Client Boundary Rules
nodes.rationale: Forbid importing server components into client components, non-serializable props, server-only/db from client components; enforce 'use client' boundaries and no root index.ts.

nodes.label: Zustand vs React Query Split
nodes.rationale: Zustand only for purely local client state; all backend data lives in React Query cache; do not duplicate data between them; use invalidateQueries/setQueryData after mutations.

nodes.label: Kebab-case Component Naming
nodes.rationale: Component files use kebab-case while the exported component stays PascalCase; a progressive migration away from PascalCase file names.

nodes.label: Module Pattern (Vertical Slices)
nodes.rationale: Every feature domain lives in src/modules/<name>/ as a vertical slice (actions.ts, schema.ts, types.ts, store.ts, hooks/, components/). Avoids a root index.ts to prevent mixing server actions with client components.

nodes.label: No Root index.ts Rule
nodes.rationale: Never use a root index.ts in modules because it can mix server actions (actions.ts) with client components, breaking Next.js App Router builds. Barrel exports only in subdirectories.

nodes.label: Cart Module (guest/auth)
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated cart is Zustand local state; authenticated cart stored in DB with Zustand as cache; merge local cart into server cart on login dedup by (perfumeId, decantId).

nodes.label: Checkout Flow
nodes.rationale: Full purchase flow cart to checkout to order to status; totals always computed server-side, never trusted from the client.

nodes.label: Cart Module
nodes.rationale: Guest cart is Zustand local state only; authenticated cart synced to backend with merge-on-login; CartItem supports full bottle (perfumeId) or decant (perfumeId + decantId).

nodes.label: Orders Module
nodes.rationale: Order status chain PENDING to CONFIRMED to SHIPPED to DELIVERED (or CANCELLED); creation is a Prisma transaction creating order + items and validating/decrementing stock atomically.

nodes.label: Shipping Rules
nodes.rationale: Free shipping for delivery with total >= 200 USD, else 5 USD; pickup has no shipping cost; totals validated server-side; order items store price at purchase time.

nodes.label: Cart Mock Frontend State
nodes.rationale: Cart view currently functional with a local mock (cart.mock.json) instead of API data; shipping rule free over 200 USD, else fixed 5 USD.

nodes.label: Orders Module
nodes.rationale: createOrder runs as an atomic transaction: validate stock, create order, create order items, decrement stock, empty the user cart.

nodes.label: Discount Coupons
nodes.rationale: Single-use discount codes (DiscountType PERCENTAGE/FIXED) with minPurchase, maxUses, expiresAt; validated against subtotal before order creation.

nodes.label: discounts Module
nodes.rationale: New vertical-slice module with types, Zod schema, actions (validateCoupon/applyCoupon/admin CRUD), React Query hook and API routes.

nodes.label: Checkout Integration Point
nodes.rationale: Coupons and gift cards are distinct concepts implemented separately but share the same integration point in Checkout.tsx + createOrder; coordinate Phase 4 of both plans.

nodes.label: Gift Cards
nodes.rationale: Persistent balance with its own currency (VES/USD) spendable across multiple purchases until exhausted; distinct from coupons, needs its own model with balance and redemption ledger.

nodes.label: GiftCard Redemption Ledger
nodes.rationale: GiftCardRedemption records amount per order; balance decremented with conditional updateMany to avoid overspend under concurrency; redemption only called inside the createOrder transaction.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Rules
nodes.rationale: Always-on rule: for codebase/architecture questions run graphify query/path/explain first, prefer wiki over raw files, and run graphify update . after modifying code.

nodes.label: Graphify Workflow
nodes.rationale: Workflow to turn a folder of files into a navigable knowledge graph following the graphify skill; default path is current directory.

nodes.label: Copilot Graphify Instructions
nodes.rationale: Instructs Copilot to query graphify first for architecture/structure questions and to only read source when the graph is missing or stale.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Project maintains a knowledge graph at graphify-out/ with god nodes, community structure and cross-file relationships; use graphify query/path/explain for codebase questions.

nodes.label: Auth Module (JWT)
nodes.rationale: Zustand store keeps JWT in memory (not localStorage for security); bcrypt hash saltRounds 12; JWT signed with JWT_SECRET, minimal payload, standard expiry 7d.

nodes.label: Google OAuth
nodes.rationale: Client obtains Google ID token, server verifies with Google API, finds or creates user by googleId/email, links account if email already exists with password, returns Aura JWT.

nodes.label: Auth Module
nodes.rationale: JWT-based auth with access token in Authorization header; Google OAuth via googleId; password is null for Google users; pending refresh tokens, password reset, email verification.

nodes.label: JWT Security Rules
nodes.rationale: userId always comes from the token, never the body, to prevent IDOR; never expose password or googleId in responses.

nodes.label: Atomic Transactions
nodes.rationale: Use db.$transaction for atomic operations such as creating an order while validating and decrementing stock.

nodes.label: ApiResult<T>
nodes.rationale: Uniform response shape { success, status, data?, message?, errors? } for every server action and API response.

nodes.label: REST API
nodes.rationale: REST endpoints under src/app/api/ following ApiResult<T>; every response adheres to the uniform ApiResult shape; API routes are thin HTTP wrappers over module actions.

nodes.label: actions.ts DB Layer
nodes.rationale: All DB logic lives in module actions.ts with import 'server-only'; db is never called from components, hooks or API routes directly.

nodes.label: Community Metrics Models
nodes.rationale: Longevity, Sillage, Season, TimeOfDay, Feeling, Projection are 1-a-1 with Perfume via perfumeId String @unique, created lazily on demand not in seed.

nodes.label: UserVote Model
nodes.rationale: UserVote deduplicated with @@unique([userId, perfumeId, category]) with category and field columns.

nodes.label: Community Votes (UserVote)
nodes.rationale: Votes deduplicated per (userId, perfumeId, category) across season, timeOfDay, longevity, sillage, projection, feeling.
